post_topic: How Showing Signal actually works: inbox-native automation when there's no public API
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right horizontal flow diagram titled 'Showing Signal: Inbox-Native Automation' in bold navy text at the top center.

Five nodes arranged in a single horizontal flow from left to right:

Node 1 (leftmost): A box labeled 'ShowingTime' with the ShowingTime logo or a simple calendar/showing icon. Below the box, a small label reads 'Sends confirmation email'.

Arrow pointing right from Node 1 to Node 2, labeled 'HTML email'.

Node 2: A box labeled 'Your Inbox' with icons for Gmail, Outlook, and a generic IMAP envelope stacked vertically inside or below it. Label below reads 'Gmail / Outlook / IMAP + App Password'.

Arrow pointing right from Node 2 to Node 3, labeled 'IMAP connection'.

Node 3 (center, slightly emphasized with an amber #F5A623 border): A box labeled 'HTML Parser' with a small code bracket icon. Below it, a callout label in amber reads 'Field-mapped from real email artifact — agent, property, time, contact'.

Arrow pointing right from Node 3 to Node 4, labeled 'Event trigger (seconds)'.

Node 4: A box labeled 'CRM Write' with a database icon.

Node 4 also has a downward arrow pointing to Node 5 directly below it.

Node 5: A box labeled 'Follow-up Sequence' with an email send icon.

A blue #5a96ff bracket or brace groups Nodes 4 and 5 together on the right side with a label 'Fires in seconds — not on a polling delay'.

No dark backgrounds. Clean connector lines. Generous whitespace between nodes.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
